title: Trump, Republicans launch ad blitz for midterms as races favor Democrats
description: Groups tied to President Donald Trump have reserved more than $130 million in advertising in recent weeks.

title: Trump and Mamdani to meet in New York
description: The president of the United States and the mayor have met three times so far.

title: Republicans’ one clear advantage this November: Money
description: Republicans’ fundraising advantage remains undiminished, especially among committees and super PACs.

title: Sen. Gary Peters, headed for academia, says he’s confident El-Sayed will win seat
description: The Michigan Democrat, who is retiring after this term, has accepted an offer at the University of Southern California.

title: Trump heads into a week of diplomacy, hampered by a lack of allies
description: At the United Nations on Tuesday and in meetings with China's Xi Jinping on Thursday, the president will largely stand alone.

title: Many GOP candidates still echo Trump's 2020 claims. Lots of voters want to move on
description: While many Republican candidates, even in some critical tossup races, still back President Trump's baseless claims about election integrity, some GOP voters say they are ready to move on.

title: The U.S. sent an Iranian Christian to Panama. It had no plan for what came next.
description: One man’s 18 months in the limbo of Trump’s third-country deportations.

title: How Trump turned a refugee bureau into a $410 million deportation operation
description: Inside the secret deals powering the president’s push to deport migrants to countries not their own.

title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico will sue Trump after being barred from White House
description: Reporters from CNN, MS NOW and Politico say they were prevented from entering the White House grounds after President Trump announced plans to ban all three outlets.

title: Trump says planned 250-foot arch will be ‘military complex’ for drones, snipers
description: The president’s post about the 250-foot arch planned near Arlington National Cemetery comes as veterans groups, historic preservationists and others attempt to stop the project.

title: President Trump navigates tough political waters with UNGA, Xi visit and AI
description: President Trump has a big week on the international stage, from the United Nations General Assembly to hosting the Chinese president at the White House.

title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
description: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

title: Trump and sons invest heavily in AI economy as he resists calls for slowdown
description: Trump’s decisions as president on one of the most consequential policy debates of his administration could affect the value of his personal investments.

title: In Colorado, a GOP candidate says his differences with Trump show he's with the voters
description: We look at Republican Congressman Jeff Hurd's campaign in Colorado, where he is using his breaks with President Trump as an asset in his bid for reelection.

title: Politics chat: Trump announces a Greenland deal, bans more media from the White House
description: We look at President Trump's announced ban of some media outlets covering the White House, as well as what a big cash windfall might mean for Republicans in the coming midterm elections.

title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
description: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

title: Thousands of planned launches, terms of deal, worry some near Louisiana SpaceX site
description: State officials say the new SpaceX site will be a $100 billion investment and launch thousands of rockets. Lawmakers  helped ease regulations and negotiations were covered under nondisclosure agreements.

title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico say journalists blocked from White House after Trump announces ban
description: President Donald Trump said Friday he would block MS NOW, CNN and Politico from White House grounds. News outlets and press advocacy groups condemned the move as a violation of the First Amendment.

title: Trump to form ‘AI Force,’ name AI czar but rejects calls for constraints
description: A growing chorus of lawmakers and industry leaders have called for moving more slowly on the technology.

title: The high stakes drama a reporter has seen covering the UN General Assembly
description: Over the years NPR's Michele Kelemen has seen high stakes diplomacy play out at the UN General Assembly.

title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
description: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."
